ev.q: The debate is often conducted as though the evidence clearly favoured one side or the other. It does not

1.why: A段末两句。C People often wrongly assume that the evidence is one-sided ↔ The debate is often conducted as though the evidence clearly favoured one side … It does not。A 正是作者否定的；B 与段首 provoke such strong feelings 相反；D 与 widely reported in the press 相反。

ev.q: its strength depended heavily on age. For students in the later years of secondary school, those who did more homework generally achieved higher results

2.why: B段。A The link with achievement was strongest for older students ↔ For students in the later years of secondary school … achieved higher results；小学生则 weak and … close to zero。D 过度：原文有 at least up to a point 的限定；B、C 与年龄差异相反。

ev.q: they showed that students who did more homework tended to do better, but not that the homework caused the improvement

3.why: C段。D could not show that homework caused better results ↔ but not that the homework caused the improvement（相关研究不能证明因果）。C 不对：随机研究的结果与其他研究一致（they, too, found larger benefits for older students），只是规模小；A、B 文中未提。

ev.q: A sensible policy would be to set little or none in the early years of primary school, to increase it gradually and with a clear purpose as students grow older

4.why: 全文主旨见G段：证据不支持任何一种极端立场，作者提出折中方案（低年级少布置或不布置，随年龄逐步增加并注重质量）。B to propose a balanced policy based on the evidence。A、C 正是作者说的两种极端；D 只对应D段的一个例子。

ev.q: very heavy loads are associated with stress, poor sleep and physical complaints such as headaches and stomach problems

5.why: D段。physical symptoms ↔ physical complaints such as headaches and stomach problems；heavy workloads ↔ very heavy loads。A段的 eats into … sleep 是家长的抱怨，不是身体症状的研究证据。

ev.q: schools can narrow the gap by running homework clubs, where pupils work with support after lessons

6.why: E段。how schools might help pupils with fewer resources ↔ schools can narrow the gap by running homework clubs。F段讲的是怎样布置更有效的作业，不是专门帮助资源少的学生。

ev.q: Students who are already motivated and well supported at home may both complete more homework and achieve higher marks, for reasons that have nothing to do with the homework itself

7.why: C段。why a statistical link might be misleading ↔ Most of the studies were correlational … students who are already motivated … may both complete more homework and achieve higher marks, for reasons that have nothing to do with the homework itself。

ev.q: have abolished homework altogether, and their decisions have been widely reported in the press

8.why: A段。schools receiving publicity for a decision ↔ schools … have abolished homework … their decisions have been widely reported in the press。D段的加州调查被广泛讨论（widely discussed），但那是一项调查，不是学校的决定，是近似干扰。

ev.q: setting tasks of this kind demands more planning from teachers, many of whom are already overloaded

9.why: F段末句。a recognition ↔ Admittedly；places demands on teachers ↔ demands more planning from teachers。

ev.q: very heavy loads are associated with stress, poor sleep and physical complaints such as headaches

10.why: D段。associated with ↔ are associated with；anxiety ↔ stress；lack of ___ ↔ poor sleep；headaches 题干已给出。

ev.q: many regarded homework as a major source of stress

11.why: D段末句。seen as a major cause of ↔ regarded … as a major source of。

ev.q: Tasks that ask students to practise skills they have already been taught, or to prepare for the next lesson

12.why: F段。practising skills already covered ↔ practise skills they have already been taught；getting ready for ↔ prepare for。

ev.q: homework that is marked and discussed in class appears to be more effective

13.why: F段。works better ↔ appears to be more effective；teachers mark it ↔ marked；in lessons ↔ in class。collected 是效果较差的做法（simply collected and returned），正好相反。

ev.q: to increase it gradually and with a clear purpose as students grow older

14.why: G段。rise step by step ↔ increase it gradually；as students age ↔ as students grow older；with an obvious ___ ↔ with a clear purpose。
